description.value: Newton Hotpot is an Asian hotpot restaurant in Surrey's Newton neighbourhood, operating at a location formerly home to Flame On Mongolian Grill. The restaurant specializes in customizable hot pot with a rotating selection of broths—Sate, Tom Yum, Kim Chi, and Miso—alongside appetizers like deep-fried wontons and salad rolls. Touring cyclists can order online for pickup or delivery, or dine in for a warming, communal meal after a long day on the road.
